summary: Rare's Battletoads began as a difficult NES beat 'em up/platform game and now has a current official route through Rare Replay alongside original and port versions.

entries.title: Battletoads
entries.definitive_edition: Rare Replay for current access; NES original for strict historical difficulty

emulation.emulator: Rare Replay built-in emulation for primary; NES emulation/hardware for comparison
emulation.notes: Disable assists when aiming for original difficulty.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original NES hardware or Rare Replay with assists disabled and state documented

primary.why: Rare Replay is the best current official access route and includes Battletoads with wrapper features such as rewind/snapshots. The NES original remains the strict difficulty/input-fidelity target, while Genesis/Game Boy/Game Gear/Amiga versions differ and should be labeled separately.
primary.how_to_play: Use Rare Replay on Xbox for current official access, disabling assists if preserving original difficulty. Record wrapper features, rewind/cheat state, snapshot use, level, player count, controller, difficulty, and whether original NES hardware or ports were compared.

secondary.exclusive_content: Strict original difficulty, two-player bug behavior, and hardware timing
secondary.why: Rare Replay is current and official but wraps the original with modern features.

secondary.platform: Genesis / Game Boy / Game Gear / Amiga
secondary.why: NES/Rare Replay is the main route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record rewind/assist state and player count.
